name: Diabetic Equipment And Supplies
old_description: Regardless of whether you live with Type 1 Diabetes or Type 2 Diabetes one thing remains…when you don’t have your supplies it is stressful and can be dangerous. We understand the critical nature of insulin pumps, CGMs and glucometers and it impacts everything we do.
about:
Diabetic Equipment and Supplies (DES) operates from Johnston, Iowa, with an additional location in Indiana, serving customers across 26 states. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

DES distributes diabetes management equipment, including insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), and glucometers. The company assigns each patient a dedicated Patient Care Coordinator who handles the entire ordering process, works with Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial insurance plans, and manages recurring resupply shipments with no shipping fees. Coordinators specialize exclusively in diabetes products and insurance navigation.

The company serves individuals with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, as well as endocrinologists, healthcare providers, diabetes educators, and other medical professionals. Its service area spans 26 states, with outreach conducted via phone, text, and email for resupply reminders and personal follow-up.

DES emphasizes a relationship-based model: calls are answered by a live person without phone trees, and coordinators proactively contact patients when supplies are due. The firm states that its staff works with diabetes products 100% of the time, positioning them as specialists in both product selection and insurance coordination.
